subject: Request: Community Accelerator — Credits & Billing Window Adjustment
messages:
From: Lina Gomes <lina@commongarden.org>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Community Accelerator — credits + billing window question

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the earlier conversation — Commons Garden is finalizing dates for our summer Community Accelerator (June 14–28) and we'd like to request a small adjustment to the credits allocation you granted us. Our mentor cohort was expanded last week and the usage forecast attached shows a ~35% bump in GPU/throughput tokens concentrated in the second week.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood top up the promo credits by 25% for the accelerator sprint, and shift the billing window so any overages incurred in the program are billed in July instead of June? This helps our sponsors reconcile expenses.
- If a top-up isn't possible, could we get a temporary trial extension for the additional cohort so we stay within the original credit envelope?

We're on a tight timeline to publish the program page (this Friday). If you can let us know by Wednesday EOD that would be ideal. I've attached the forecast and a short summary of cohort changes.

Appreciate the help — Lina

--
Lina Gomes
Head of Programs | Commons Garden
orga@commongarden.org | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Lina — thanks for the details and the forecast. Quick clarifying Qs before I take this to finance/ops:

1) Is the +35% additional usage scope all from inference (token gen) or does it include embedding/derivative workloads? Your spreadsheet looks inference-heavy but I want to be explicit.
2) If we apply a July billing window for overages, does Commons Garden have a PO or a billing contact who will accept an invoice in July? We need a named approver for ledger and net-30 terms.

Initial gut: we can likely do a targeted one-off top-up tied to the accelerator program dates, but I need to loop in David in finance to confirm the billing-window exception (we've done this for a few partners before, subject to approvals). Marissa — tagging you for ops/quotas and to confirm whether a temporary quota bump is needed vs issuing one-off credits.

If you can reply with the two items above (inference vs embeddings split + billing contact/PO), I will push this through today.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks — I looked at the attached forecast. Ops notes:
- If Commons Garden needs a 25% top-up, we can grant one-off promo credits tied to the accelerator project code (proj: CG-ACC-2026). That avoids modifying tenant-level quotas.
- For the billing-window exception, finance (David) will need the PO number and an email from the Commons Garden billing contact approving July invoice placement. We can record the exception in the deal notes.
- Timing: to have credits applied by June 10 (so cohorts can run smoke tests), we need approvals by Wednesday EOD.

I attached a small runbook (CommunityCredits_TnC_v3.pdf) with conditions we usually include (no resale, usage reporting after program, credit expiration 30 days after program end).

If David gives the green light, I can create the promo code and drop it into the Commons Garden partner record.

—Marissa

Hi Neha / Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

1) Usage breakdown: estimate is 88% inference (token generation for mentor demos and student projects), 12% embeddings (search/indexing). The attached XLSX has the per-day breakdown and peak hour assumptions.
2) Billing: our finance lead is Claire Huang (claire.huang@commongarden.org). We will send a PO this week and Claire can confirm OK to accept July invoice if Redwood issues one. PO reference: CG-2026-ACCEL-PO (we'll send the scanned PO with the confirmation email).

We accept the T&C conditions in your attached runbook. If you can provision the promo code and keep the billing-window as July for any overage, that's ideal. We really appreciate the fast turn here — it makes a big difference for our mentors.

Best,
Lina

Lina — all set. Summary of actions and approvals:

- Finance (David Kim) approved a one-time promo credit top-up of 25% tied to proj: CG-ACC-2026. Credits will be issued as a promo code and applied to the partner project; no tenant quota changes required. See HubSpot deal for record: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/RDW-CR-2026-034
- Billing exception granted: Commons Garden invoice for any overages incurred during the accelerator (June 14–28) will be generated in July; Claire Huang (claire.huang@commongarden.org) is our PO contact per your note. Please attach the PO when you send the confirmation email.
- Ops (Marissa) will create the promo code and add usage reporting requirements. Marissa — please confirm promo code name and expiry (recommend: CG-ACCEL-25P-2026, expiry 2026-07-31).

Next steps for Lina: send PO and confirmation email to david_kim@redwood.com and reply-all so we have the record. I'll mark the deal stage as "credits approved" in HubSpot.

Happy to help get the cohort live — let me know if you need a short blurb about Redwood in the program materials.
